content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

The architecture behind selling design assets with crypto payments is about building a sovereign digital commerce stack that is entirely under your control. By utilizing tools like Cloudflare Workers for backend logic and NOWPayments for payment processing, creators can establish a system that avoids the high fees and limitations imposed by platforms like Gumroad. This matters because it empowers digital creators to retain more of their earnings and maintain complete ownership of their products, giving them a sustainable business model in an otherwise restrictive environment.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, the architecture leverages free hosting solutions like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, combined with backend services such as Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Once a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments processes the crypto transaction, converting the payment to USD at transaction time. This setup not only ensures low transaction fees—0.5% compared to Gumroad's 10%—but also allows for automated delivery of digital products directly to customers. The result is a streamlined process that maximizes efficiency and profitability for creators.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment platforms are limited or unavailable. If you're selling ebooks, templates, beats, or any digital asset, this system provides a way to bypass the restrictions imposed by platforms like PayPal or Gumroad. By adopting this architecture, creators gain autonomy over their sales, allowing them to focus on what they do best: creating high-quality digital products. It's an opportunity to build a sustainable income without the financial drain of conventional platforms.
Eliminate high fees with NOWPayments—only 0.5% per transaction.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereignty of your digital commerce stack hinges on several key components working in harmony. First, you need a hosting solution like GitHub Pages for your site. Next, integrate backend logic through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for managing orders and automating delivery. NOWPayments will handle your crypto transactions seamlessly, allowing for a wide array of cryptocurrencies. Finally, utilize tools like Supabase or Google Sheets for order tracking. Each component plays a vital role in ensuring a smooth operation, giving you full control over your business.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, select the tools that best fit your needs. Begin by setting up your website on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, implement backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage your digital products. Then, integrate NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency transactions. Load your initial products and test the system to ensure smooth operation. This knowledge empowers you to deploy a fully functional sovereign commerce stack today, enabling you to sell your digital products directly to your audience.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing a sovereign digital commerce stack that operates independently. By using platforms like GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, you can manage your sales directly. This method eliminates the need for conventional payment processors, allowing you to retain more of your earnings while ensuring immediate product delivery.
Own your entire sales process, from product delivery to payment processing.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for a complete solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates needed to build and deploy your own sovereign digital commerce stack. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, and start selling without the restrictions of conventional platforms.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions

To set up your online store without PayPal or Stripe, use GitHub Pages for hosting and integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payment processing. This allows you to manage everything independently, without relying on conventional payment platforms.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments charges a fee of just 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%. This fee structure allows you to retain more of your earnings from each sale.
Can I sell digital products on my own website?

Yes, you can sell digital products on your own website using a sovereign digital commerce stack. By utilizing tools like Cloudflare Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing, you maintain full control over your sales.
Is there a way to automate product delivery?

Yes, you can automate product delivery using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. These tools can manage the transaction flow and ensure that customers receive their digital products instantly upon payment confirmation.
What types of digital products can I sell with this setup?

You can sell a variety of digital products including ebooks, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. This infrastructure is flexible enough to accommodate any type of digital asset you wish to market.
